name: Jezero Crater crewed EVA traverse (reference report)
region_note: Jezero Crater (~18.4N, 77.4E). This is NOT inside the Gale Crater region (137-138E, 6-4S): do not apply the Gale bounding box to this scenario.

waypoints.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing
waypoints.unit: Smooth basaltic volcanic floor; touchdown datum anchor.

waypoints.name: Crater Floor (Maaz)
waypoints.unit: Fractured igneous lava flows; first rock abrasion targets.

waypoints.name: Seitah (South Seitah)
waypoints.unit: Olivine cumulate bedrock and active sand megaripples.

waypoints.name: Three Forks
waypoints.unit: Flat delta apron; 10-tube backup sample depot.

waypoints.name: Delta Front (Hawksbill Gap)
waypoints.unit: Steep delta scarp; laminated mudstone beds.

waypoints.name: Delta Top (Tenby / Belva Rim)
waypoints.unit: Delta fan plateau with coarse boulder conglomerates.

waypoints.name: Neretva Vallis
waypoints.unit: Inflow canyon floor carved by ancient paleofloods.

segments.class: Flat depot apron to scarp toe
Steep delta scarp (local up to 18 deg)
Steep scree slope (local up to 23 deg)

science_activities.1: Initial suit telemetry checkout, navigation antenna lock, baseline dust monitoring (preparation).
science_activities.2: Igneous bedrock inspection; pyroxene/basalt petrographic sampling.
science_activities.3: Sampling olivine-cumulate layers; aeolian sand granule sizing and grain sorting.
science_activities.4: Inspection of the 10-tube backup sample depot; photographic documentation.
science_activities.5: Laminated mudstone logging; carbonate/clay biosignature screening.
science_activities.6: Coarse conglomerate analysis; Belva Crater ejecta blocks.
science_activities.7: Channel floor paleoflood gravel mapping and flow-regime analysis.
science_activities.9: Impact basement sampling; panoramic geological context survey.

config.limit_note: xEMU 8.0 h nominal + 30 min reserve as stated in the source report; verify against NASA JSC documentation before publishing.

reference.source: calcualtions.pdf (Jezero EVA report). Values copied from the report for verification.
